label: MY_IOT_ADAPTER
description: Infineon’s Shield2Go boards offer a unique customer and evaluation experience – the boards are equipped with one Infineon IC and come with a ready to use Arduino library. Customers can now develop their own system solutions by combining Shield2Go boards together with Infineon My IoT adapters.
